name: Commodity L1 liquidity depletion and provision
sample: Use commodity main-contract L1 close summaries, research minute-shard daily bar fields, and annual universe/prior-year turnover metadata for 2011-01-01 through 2021-12-31. Do not load factor caches, fees, slippage, roll-yield, open-interest, or warehouse data. Include each product only in years when it belongs to the research pool rebuilt with the prior-year turnover screen; require the rebuilt 2015 pool to match the saved pool. The on-disk L1 files cover different product-specific subperiods; use pairwise complete observations and report each product's dates, years, and sample count. Do not read 2022 or 2026 (不读 2022；不读 2026), do not read 2023-2025 locked partitions, and do not use forward data. These overlapping research dates have been examined previously; this is exploratory, not OOS validation.

liquidity_depletion.signal: Tick midpoint close location, (final valid L1 midpoint - daily low)/(daily high - daily low), on the decision day
liquidity_depletion.spread_outcome: Mean relative quoted spread in the last 30 minutes divided by its day-session mean
liquidity_depletion.depth_outcome: Mean displayed best-bid plus best-ask size in the last 30 minutes divided by its day-session mean
liquidity_depletion.interpretation: A weak close (low close location) coincides with wider relative spreads and thinner displayed L1 depth near the close.

liquidity_provision.outcome: Next-session intraday return: (next trading day's closew - openw)/next trading day's raw open

states.wider_spread: For each product, the spread ratio is above its trailing 250-observation median, calculated using only prior observations and requiring at least 125.
states.thinner_depth: For each product, the depth ratio is below its trailing 250-observation median, calculated using only prior observations and requiring at least 125.

liquidity_provision.interpretation: A negative close-location slope is a rebound after weak closes; a more negative slope when liquidity is worse is consistent with liquidity provision or transient price pressure, not causal proof.

order_flow.predictor: Last-30-minute Lee-Ready signed-volume imbalance, where positive is net buying
order_flow.expected_direction: Report descriptively; no directional pass criterion.
order_flow.interpretation: Check whether low closes coincide with net selling and whether signed flow explains the next-session rebound after controlling for close location.

parameters.reference_pool: Year-y research pool selected only from year y-1 turnover and valid days.
parameters.l1_symbols: All product CSVs present in data/commodity/external_rqdata/l1_close at run time, restricted to products in the year-specific research pool and classified by the preregistered time_factor_screen sector map.
parameters.minute_fields: Aggregate only open, openw, closew, and trading_date from the guarded research minute shards to calculate next-session intraday returns.
parameters.horizon: Next regular day-session open-to-close return; no close-to-next-open gap in the primary outcome.
parameters.sector_aggregation: Equal-weight product means within the active research pool on each date; require at least two products with complete inputs for the model.
parameters.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment separately for each preregistered model family across eligible products and, separately, across eligible sectors. Report raw HAC t and adjusted q; exploratory support requires the preregistered direction and q <= 0.10.

models: Next-session intraday return on midpoint close location.
Relative tail spread and relative tail depth separately on midpoint close location.
Next-session intraday return on close location, worse-liquidity state, and their interaction; run separately for wider spread and thinner depth.
Next-session intraday return on close location and tail signed-volume imbalance.
reporting.strata: Report every eligible product and sector, including coefficients, standard errors or HAC t, q-values, sample size, year span, and coverage; do not report only significant rows.
partitions_read: Commodity research minute shards (open, openw, closew, trading_date only).
Commodity annual universe and prior-year turnover statistics.
Commodity L1 close summaries for dates no later than 2021-12-31.
reporting.interpretation_limit: These observational mechanism diagnostics cannot identify causality. A positive result is in-sample evidence consistent with the hypothesis, not proof of liquidity provision.

post_hoc_data_quality_sensitivity.added_at: 2026-10-27, after the primary results and L1 range checks
post_hoc_data_quality_sensitivity.reason: Tick midpoint close location can fall outside [0, 1] because it is measured against traded high/low; the BB file contains especially large outliers in a short, ineligible history.
post_hoc_data_quality_sensitivity.rule: Keep the declared raw-midpoint analysis as primary. Separately clip midpoint close location to [0, 1], recompute the close-location interactions, and rerun every declared model with the same sample, eligibility thresholds, HAC lags, and BH correction. Save as sensitivity outputs; do not use them to replace or select the primary result.
